title: Apocryphal Acts and Apocalypses of the New Testament
attributionNote: A compilation of anonymous or pseudonymous texts; the volume editor's arrangement is what this catalogue records.
description: The apocryphal acts, epistles and apocalypses printed in the Ante-Nicene Fathers: the Acts of Peter, Paul, Thomas, John and Andrew, the apocalypses of Peter and Paul, and related texts. Several are encratite or Gnostic-influenced, and the Acts of Thomas in particular carries a strong Syrian ascetic and Gnostic colouring.
historicalContext: Popular narrative literature of the second to fourth centuries, widely read but excluded from the canon; the translations here are Victorian and reflect their editors' judgements about which texts to include.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the CCEL volume page at read time. The Ante-Nicene Fathers translation, served by the CCEL. This is a compilation volume rather than a single ancient work; chapter labels follow the volume's own divisions.
